headline: Meta unveils Muse Charm, a Tamagotchi-like wearable AI companion device
summary: Meta unveiled the Muse Charm, a Tamagotchi-like wearable powered by its Muse AI agent, at its Connect keynote, alongside plans to bring Muse to its AI glasses. Coverage says the toy-like device can interact with other Charms, taps into a broader accessory trend, and follows backlash over Meta's earlier smart glasses, even as Meta insists Muse is meant only for adults.
